subject: English
passage:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes:
• The Awakening Years (2018) is a bildungsroman by Nigerian author Chidinma Okafor.
• Bildungsromans are novels that focus on the psychological and moral growth of a protagonist.
• These novels typically follow a protagonist from childhood or adolescence into adulthood.
• The Awakening Years follows the journey of Isabella Cruz, a medical student navigating her transformation from adolescence to adulthood in Lagos.
prompt: The student wants to provide an example of a bildungsroman. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?

choices.A: In 2018, Nigerian author Chidinma Okafor published a novel following Isabella Cruz, a medical student navigating her transformation from adolescence to adulthood.
choices.B: Following the journey of Isabella Cruz, a medical student navigating her transformation from adolescence to adulthood in Lagos, Chidinma Okafor's The Awakening Years is a bildungsroman.
choices.C: It was Chidinma Okafor who published the novel The Awakening Years in 2018.
choices.D: A bildungsroman is a novel that focuses on the psychological and moral growth of a protagonist, typically from childhood or adolescence into adulthood.

explanation: Choice B is the best answer because it most effectively provides an example of a bildungsroman by explicitly identifying The Awakening Years as one and including relevant details that demonstrate why it fits the category. The sentence names the specific work, identifies its author (Chidinma Okafor), and describes the protagonist Isabella Cruz's journey from adolescence to adulthood in Lagos—a characteristic feature of bildungsromans noted in the student's research. This synthesis of information from multiple notes creates a complete example.
